finding_summary: Global Result inventory rejects unrelated committed legacy Result records without result_id before exact response_to_instruction_id target selection, preventing the otherwise uniquely bound R3 handoff.

finding_detail.required_behavior: Tolerate unrelated committed clean parseable legacy Results lacking IDs; retain global duplicate nonempty Result ID reconciliation; exact current target must have a nonempty string ID and exactly one instruction-response match, with every existing target, identity, STATE, Git, scope, evidence and remote validation retained.
finding_detail.bounds: No synthetic IDs or historical Result changes; preserve STATE legacy repo-relative result reference and compact renderer DURABLE_RESULT_REF_REQUIRED; no Kernel/version/registry change; no physical retirement replay; L7 stays denied.

review_context: Independent repository read-only reviewer; implementation context withheld. Native reproduction used python -X utf8 -B to prevent Windows locale decoding interference.
